topic: Whole-operation DXF write allocation rollback and retry
purpose: Sweep one-shot allocation failures across the public dxfRW::write operation, including setup, record emission, finalization, and output publication, to complement per-callback P6 transaction controls.

procedure.allocationScope: Global operator-new fault injection is armed only during dxfRW::write. One-time warm-up writer state is initialized before calibrating each encoding. Each failure is one-shot so diagnostic handling and same-codec retry can proceed normally.

limits: This generated transaction control exercises one LINE and one raw XRECORD; it is not exhaustive coverage of every whole-drawing allocation path, record family, platform, or filesystem failure mode.
Same-library typed readback and byte-identical retry establish transaction behavior only, not independent interoperability or format-support claims.
No DWG or DXF fixture file is committed. Generated output is created in the test scratch directory and removed after each encoding.
